title: Malaysian Rice Pudding
description: A creamy and comforting dessert inspired by Malaysian cuisine. Made with rice, pudding mix, and a touch of velvety coconut milk.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the rice, pudding mix, sugar, and salt. Whisk until well combined.
Add in the melted butter and velvety coconut milk. Whisk until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the pudding has reached desired consistency.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
